title: Ion transport for simultaneous nickel electrodeposition and sulfuric acid recovery in single-membrane, dual-chamber electrolyzers
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12226-12237
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09684G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qiaoling Xian, Jian Zhou, Hongyi Liu, Chao Guo, Yan Lu, Xinyang Zhou
Membrane electrolysis in a single-membrane dual-cell system was applied for nickel deposition. Ion changes in both chambers were tracked to evaluate transport behavior and feasibility, and five AEMs were compared for electrolytic performance.
